item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 05/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure over Guangdong is expected to develop into a cold front tomorrow, and move across the coast of Guangdong between tomorrow night and Friday morning. There will be showers and a few thunderstorms over the region. Temperatures will fall slightly. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be windy and brighter over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend. With the northeast monsoon moderating early next week, the weather will improve with temperatures rising over the region.
